notes: Tuning for people. Each section belongs to one module: founding (src/people/founding.rs), needs (src/people/needs.rs), actions (src/people/decide.rs), life (src/people/life.rs), status (src/people/status.rs), economy (src/economy.rs), tools (src/tools.rs), caravan (src/caravan.rs).
All numbers are integers. Shares and multipliers are per mille.

founding.age_table_note: [lowest age of a five-year band, per mille of people in it]: a pre-modern population with life expectancy around 30.
founding.skill_share_note: Each adult knows each of the city's non-baseline technologies with this chance (if they know its prerequisites). Children know the baseline.

notes: Urgency runs from 0 (satisfied) to 1000 (desperate). Needs are brought up to date once a day, at nightfall: they grow, the day's action satisfies some of them, then the night's sleep.
growth_per_day: how much each need grows in a day. Food is satisfied by eating (economy), family by partners and children (life), esteem by status (status); this module only grows them.
rest_awake_per_day: tiredness from a full waking day; night_sleep: what a night in shelter by the fire satisfies.

warmth: below comfort_tenths (tenths of a degree C, at night on the home tile) warmth grows per_degree_per_day for every degree; season_extra_per_day adds damp and short days per season (spring, summer, autumn, winter, as felt in the city's hemisphere).
safety: disaster_per_day extra growth while a disaster killed people in the city within the last disaster_days days.

One entry per action. serves: how much a day of it satisfies each need (also how strongly that need draws people to it; food, family and esteem are satisfied by economy, life and status, so for them it is only the draw). duration_turns: how long it lasts (a turn is a quarter day, the waking day is 3 turns; longer actions are resumed each morning).

Requirements: min_age; techs_any (knowing any one of these technology ids); land (the city has free land, or the person worked it yesterday); water (the city is on a river, lake or coast); unpartnered; parents (has children); settle_away (the city has no free land, few days of food, and the person has been hungry for a while). children: children may follow their mother in it.
traits: leaning toward the action, added to its score in full for a trait of 255 and subtracted in full for 0 (128 is neutral).

urgent: a need at or above this urgency that was not urgent when the current action was chosen makes a person decide again at once. noise: the random part of every score, 0 to this. pressing_food: hunger at which a day counts toward settle_away.hungry_days.

economy.territory_radius_km_note: A city holds the tiles within this distance that no other city is nearer to, and always its own tile.
economy.work_turns_per_day_note: Turns (quarter days) of work that make a full day's work.
economy.land_work_note: catchment_km2: land within walking distance that is worked (fields about 5 km around the village, herds about 15 km, foragers about 20 km). workers_per_100_km2: workers the best land (quality 1000) takes. daily_yield: food from a day's work on the best land, thousandths of a person-day (one adult's food for a day).
economy.fish_note: Fishers each kind of water within the territory takes; without nets or boats they catch without_gear per mille.
economy.unfarmable_note: Farmed only with a technology whose 'farmable' effect applies there (yams in rainforest, potatoes or terraces in mountains).
economy.pasture_note: Grazing quality of each biome, per mille.
economy.forage_floor_note: Foraging quality is this plus the rest scaled by fertility: game and wild plants are found even on poor land.
economy.growing_season_note: Fields grow in a season whose long-term mean is at least 5 C (hundredths) and which gets at least 60 mm of rain (tenths of a mm), or on a river or lake. The crop is harvested at the end of the last growing season.
economy.off_season_note: Per mille of output outside the growing season (herds, foraging) and in seasons with a mean below freezing (fishing).
economy.storage_note: Food up to (base_months + food_storage months) x 30 days per resident keeps well and loses stored_loss per 100 000 a day; the rest loses open_loss. preservation effects cut both, by at most max_preservation per mille.
economy.eating_note: Children below child_age eat child_ration per mille of an adult's food. A full day's food lowers the Food need by full_meal; a short ration by that share.
